game_title: Boolean Circuit – Cinder Cone Camp Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp, a camp on a cinder slope: the fire warden must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the cooling vent.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Cinder Cone Camp: a camp on a cinder slope
core_gameplay_loop: In Cinder Cone Camp, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the cooling vent. Each round, a new ore chunks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 390 points of ore chunks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ash wraiths in Cinder Cone Camp.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 390 within 36 seconds.
